  • Method Details

    • externalTitle

      public DialogProviderBase.DialogDataBuilder externalTitle(net.minecraft.network.chat.Component externalTitle)
      Sets the title used where the dialog is referenced from the outside, for example in a dialog list. Defaults to the regular title.

    • canCloseWithEscape

      public DialogProviderBase.DialogDataBuilder canCloseWithEscape(boolean canCloseWithEscape)
      Sets whether the dialog can be closed by pressing escape. Defaults to true.

    • pause

      public DialogProviderBase.DialogDataBuilder pause(boolean pause)
      Sets whether the game is paused while the dialog is open. Defaults to true. A pausing dialog must use an after action that unpauses the game again.

    • afterAction

      public DialogProviderBase.DialogDataBuilder afterAction(net.minecraft.server.dialog.DialogAction afterAction)
      Sets what happens after a button of this dialog has been clicked. Defaults to DialogAction.CLOSE.

    • body

      public DialogProviderBase.DialogDataBuilder body(net.minecraft.network.chat.Component contents)
      Adds a plain text paragraph to the dialog body.

    • body

      public DialogProviderBase.DialogDataBuilder body(net.minecraft.server.dialog.body.DialogBody... body)
      Adds elements to the dialog body.

    • input

      public DialogProviderBase.DialogDataBuilder input(String key, net.minecraft.server.dialog.input.InputControl control)
      Adds an input control to the dialog. Its value can be referenced by actions of this dialog through the given key.

    • input

      public DialogProviderBase.DialogDataBuilder input(net.minecraft.server.dialog.Input... inputs)
      Adds input controls to the dialog.
